package.name: mighty_bridge
package.description: Adapter between the MIGHTY planner and AirStack's local-planner seam: serves the NavigateTask action, converts odometry to dynus State (twist rotated to world frame), feeds route checkpoints as term_goal, and converts MIGHTY's committed Trajectory into TrajectoryXYZVYaw segments for the trajectory controller (ADD_SEGMENT mode). Also hosts the OPT-IN native MIGHTY->PX4 setpoint path (MIGHTY_NATIVE_SETPOINTS): mighty_node's 100 Hz dynus Goal streamed straight to mavros/setpoint_raw/local as mavros_msgs/PositionTarget, muting pid_controller for exactly that window.
